entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
I need to start a return. Now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. I can certainly help you with...
Right, a return. Can I get a yes or no on this? I don't have all day. Order number is VF-8675309.

Of course. One moment while I pull up that order. VF-8675309... I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered about 35 days ago. To get this started, I just need to quickly clarify, what specifically is the issue with the band?

It's just not what I wanted. It's surprisingly hard to use, and the menu is confusing. I even read the user manual, but I honestly expected more for the price. Look, I'm not interested in a tutorial. Just tell me if I can send it back for a refund.
I understand completely. No problem at all, you just want a straightforward answer. Let me check the return eligibility for you. I'm looking at our policy now.
Okay, I see you received it 35 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the window. I can absolutely approve this return for you.
Good. So you're sending a label?

Yes. And as you are one of our VIP customers, I've processed it with complimentary priority shipping. The return label is on its way to your email right now. You'll receive a full refund once our warehouse receives the item.
Fine. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
